title: The Dark of the Arno
subtitle: A tree that bears sweet and sour pears can never produce sweet figs!

items.text:
Come forth, prayers of the night!

Our blood reddens the offering; our tears blacken the Arno.

Our children are reborn among the blooming flowers,

While the face of God vanishes from the painted frame.
We are the corrupted.
Temporary Workshop
Dim candlelight flickers over errant books and draft papers, casting shadows on the wall.
Leonardo is fully engrossed within the book held in front of him.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: "They sang and danced to the heretic's music."

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: "Then they cut their wrists to shed blood; mixed it with hair and soil and painted the mixture on the wall."

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: "The air smelled strange. I started to laugh and dance just like they did ..."
*creak*
The door is cracked followed by the sound of heels stepping on the old wooden floor.
Despite the noises, the man doesn't stir from his book.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: "Blood on the wall, reborn from the flesh."
The one who entered the room halts their steps.
And all falls completely mute.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: What?!
Leonardo at last takes notice of the figure in the room.
As it approaches him like a ghost from the shadows.
Right behind him, creeping closer and closer.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Good evening ...?
The "ghost" shrouds Leonardo and his book in its shadow and whispers to him ...
"Blood on the wall, I am reborn."

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Ahhh!!
Leonardo jumps like a frightened rabbit, stirring up the pages on the ground.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What's wrong, Mr. Leonardo? I was only reading the rest of the spell.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh, I get it. You were having fun reading those horror stories all alone. I understand, I do love a good ghost story!

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: You might've considered knocking, my lady.
The young lady snorts presumptuously.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Leonardo? Mr. Leonardo? Mr. Leonardo!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I called your name three times in a row! But no one answered!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: How could you be so rude as to ignore your patroness? I didn't mean to scare you, but Miss Sotheby has no time to waste.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: My apologies. I've been entranced in the words ... It's a record of the Compliners' ritual. The author claims to have been part of it and escaped alive.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The ones you've mentioned before? That nasty group of gremlins that used to meet in the cathedral in secret?

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Yes. They are also the ones who have secreted away the relics that Ezio is searching for.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: My messenger must have told you why I invited you to come by. Your father just confiscated some manuscripts ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh, I think you're mistaken! Mr. Domenico is not my father. Though I am very grateful for his help.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: He's not your father? But I was certain that you were introduced as such.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It's a long story.
The young lady looks up wistfully as she recalls the events.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I was wandering around the Palazzo when some gentlemen arrived. As I recall, they were all members of the Decemviri.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: One of them was Mr. Domenico! All of a sudden he rushed up to me and asked if I was his daughter, he said that I had gone missing many years ago.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Hmm ... No offense, my lady, but that sounds a little like how they kidnap children in Santa Croce.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Thank you for the reminder, Mr. Leonardo, but Sotheby is a mature young lady who can protect herself! After all, I'm standing here talking to you in one piece!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Anyway, he started crying about the garden he had built for her and how it had all the rarest plants he could find ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: He even said he had Tahitian bridal veil, Egyptian privet, and devil's tree! So ...

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: *sigh* Fortune certainly seems to be on your side.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Now, did he give you the manuscripts? I can't imagine he would say no to his long-lost daughter.
The young lady nods proudly.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ta-da! Miss Sotheby already took the liberty of checking them all. This one is well-crafted and has the most details.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It was confiscated from a book merchant. He said ...
The young lady clears her throat before she continues.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: "It has a silk cover, tempera painting, and gilded edges. Buy it now, and I'll throw in a free collection of Dante's poetry!!"

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Begin the Maenalian verses with me, my flute.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: How was that? Miss Sotheby has been practicing her Latin!

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: ... Brava! Your "father" would be moved to tears if he heard that.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Now that I've given you a hand, could you ...
The young lady is struck by an uncharacteristic shyness.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Hmm? Don't tell me you want to join ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: That's right! Please let me join in your adventure!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Take me to the cathedral with you!
The young lady seems to almost float with anticipation.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: I'm sorry, my lady. But this is not the sort of adventure suitable for a young woman.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: I barely survived my own encounter with the Templars. Don't presume that they will show you mercy simply because you are a nobleman's daughter.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: My lady, I'm sorry, but I could never forgive myself if I let you be hurt. Whatever "adventure" awaits us at Il Duomo, I do not believe it will be fun.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: There's no need to worry. Miss Sotheby can protect herself and more than just that ...
She raises her head proudly, adopting a proud and noble pose.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I can make potions, aid in teamwork, research critters, read Latin, give orders, and even fight any villains we may find!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Just let me prove it!
Leonardo may be a man of many talents, but fighting is not one of them, and soon he ends up cornered by the little arcanist.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hooray! My screaming roots and popeye slime worked!

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Calm down, my lady ... Alright, please have mercy. You can join us. You've more than proved your ability.
Hands on the head, Leonardo rushes toward the door, trying to run away from the little witch.
*thud*

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Ouch! Who could this be ...

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: It seems like I've missed a party.

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Ezio, Mr. APPLe! I knew you would get rid of those Templars!

items.speaker: Leonardo
items.text: Oh, and you've even brought us a new friend.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Good evening, Mister Leonardo. I've heard a lot about you—on my way here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm? That lady behind you ...
As heels hit the wooden floor again, a green tornado swooshes by Leonardo and charges forward.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Vertin!!
A heartwarming reunion. The young lady can't help hugging her friend in a swirling embrace.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: *sob* You're finally here! Have you any idea what I've been through? Miss Sotheby had to attend classes and even study Latin!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: And my teachers were even stricter than Mr. Karson!
The anxiety of exploring a new place is all at once driven away.
She takes a deep breath to enjoy the moment. Taking in the pleasant smells of the Tuscan air; with odd hints of citrus and the unmistakable smell of goat cheese.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm so glad I've finally found you, Sotheby.
